notes.title: AploVVare Collection v1.7 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Happy 2025, I'm back with not one, two, nor three, but FOUR new games!! Yippee!!

Mouse Mouse

Mouse Mouse is a short platformer where you control a mouse using your mouse!

This was made for Ludum Dare 56, the original version only had one level so I decided to add two more just to fluff it up a bit

FEARMONGER

FEARMONGER is a short narrative game about a home intruder, this was made as a secret santa gift

(this one is pretty political, if that's not your cup of tea i added an option to skip it and get the achievement at the very start)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44477116/d6124ee7b8e6d51a2681be1177692e3cfc7097d2.png

TANKeMON TCG

TANKeMON TCG is a card pack opening simulator featuring Newgrounds characters! This was made for Newgrounds Pixel Day 2025

BATTERY ACID: ZEITGEIST

BATTERY ACID: ZEITGEIST is an endless boss rush shoot 'em up and is an indrect sequel to BATTERY ACID! This was made for Boss Rush Jam 2025

(Honestly I might come back to this one in the future and expand upon it a little)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44477116/d4b0aa1edd3f0a4fcb9577121c12967ac908b284.png

In case you don't follow me on Twitter/Bluesky/Itch/etc. I've been working on a sequel to Solace Inc. for the past I think 7 months now...? and a demo will be coming soon to Steam!

If you all could do me a huge favor and SMASH that wishlist button I would greatly appreciate it!! 🙏

SOLACE INC 2 STEAM PAGE

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44477116/9956ec9b6c6b0590f10211a8149fa2f8ffc7bdbf.png

That's all for now, thank you for playing! As always lmk if you run into any issues

notes.title: AploVVare Collection v1.6 Update
notes.content:
Heya! Been a few months, I've got some more games for you guys! (+one i meant to add forever ago and forgot to lol)

UNWORTHY

UNWORTHY is a short roguelike about an artist and their journey to become a Champion. Gather materials and draw your masterpiece, gain power from your art through Muses, and slay foes on your way to present your work to The Judge.

Made in 96 hours for GMTK Jam 2024

Jim Brimstone: Devil Advocate

Jim Brimstone: Devil Advocate is a short visual novel where you play as the world's worst lawyer. Lie, deny, and manipulate your client's way to freedom!

Made in 72 hours for Ludum Dare 55

notes.title: AploVVare Collection v1.4 Update
notes.content:
Hey gamers! I'm back with 2 new games for you, one I made earlier this year and one I released yesterday!

Cthulhu Merge

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44477116/0e539a476be62ce8b0cc9b2517bb4e599ea232bd.png

Cthulhu Merge is a suika-like game where you merge woodland creatures to summon our great lord, Cthulhu!

This was made as a secret santa gift for someone, it's pretty small

Wishlist

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44477116/2682030e057c482b3edb8a2dc80457e634201ba2.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44477116/8029f03cf7c513055b0ea433d0e6664eef7255de.png

Wishlist is a ""deckbuilding roguelike"" where you build a video game one card at a time and market it through social media. You gain wishlists from your post's likes and shares, and you have to meet the quota before time is up or else you'll have to start over.

This was made in a few days just for the hell of it

I also added a clickable banner that shows up when you select Solace Inc., just as a reminder that it's on Steam

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44477116/53ce75d9b57a13073967e4c21f086462f9b99c7d.png

Thanks for playing! Enjoy!

notes.title: AploVVare Collection v1.3 Update
notes.content:
Hey knuckleheads! Happy Holidays! I got you guys an early Christmas present!

This update includes a pretty large update for Solace Inc. that I've been cooking for the past month or so, along with an extra game I made recently.

Solace Inc. v1.3

This is a pretty large update, which adds a BUNCH of new recruits (the total is over 100 now) along with some new missions, new meta progression, new mechanics, new dialogue, and a lot more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44477116/9b67198ff2741d441812c6e67faa352dfa41dc5e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44477116/37367b027fb2b331214b318bd5171c419473001d.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44477116/323fc18c78b291d7897bdcdb868f8b381a81a4ca.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44477116/887921296708b24e19a6486d95f9b49bf8545307.png

(It's practically a completely different game at this point, if it gets any larger I might have to make a separate Steam page)

Since I changed how unlocking recruits functions, you'll basically lose all progress from the previous versions aside from what stages you've unlocked, but it'll be a fresh new experience!

Solace Inc. Mobile Version

A mobile version of Solace Inc. is in the works! It's my first mobile game, and am super hyped to release it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44477116/9ef6788da885d551df3d1d241bad7283a8abba4d.png

I was planning on having it released on the same day as this update, but Google Play recently changed how mobile games are launched so it's now a much longer process (ugh) so it'll most likely be a post-christmas release

There She Is!

There She Is! is a short puzzle game made for the Confounding Calendar where you search for a woman within a sea of women

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44477116/7e05178f30a041d41a7981bd0844f81871a171ff.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44477116/e5634f30cb2c5f2fcc91d078c2e0c8d06125a8cb.png

New Launcher Skin

New festive launcher skin for the Supporter DLC! Ah, so jolly!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44477116/c285bd86ff59fdb942f16019983ff1e4386c23e8.png

Been looking forward to this update, hope you all enjoy! Merry Christmas & Happy Holidays!

notes.title: AploVVare Collection v1.2 Update
notes.content:
Hey knuckleheads! I've got a new game for you, and a big update to an existing one!

I was going to release this sooner but uhhh... got a little bit carried away with new Solace Inc. content, so hopefully this was worth the wait!

Mitruvian Van

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44477116/e9f80ab208b64e46be0af3b037c47334771d9cbe.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44477116/c1ba4a802be507a19ebf4f8d091fd0635bcbfd3a.png

Mitruvian Van is a linalike immersive sim where everything is random and you must kill.

This game is aggressively random. It may be easy, it may be impossible. There are no 'solutions' available. Nothing is predetermined, that's up to you.

I made this late October after being inspired by Mosa Lina by stuffedwombat, and decided to make my own spin on the concept. It has boobs, guns, and explosions!

Solace Inc. v1.2

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44477116/48e109564262203c13126ff61c4124ce5c0e00e6.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44477116/bb67f949bd730c54bb5076ed43691c2ce57b096b.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44477116/c94115dc0a0ffb9f14d9a3771f3399a767dbd698.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44477116/507267344adf9acaa6589bae8493bf7bc0adf03f.png

I decided to revisit Solace Inc. and added some more recruits, missions, and more! I also made some changes to the currently existing recruits and missions. I've also added loot crates which will are rare drops that upgrade both the actives and passives of 3 random recruits. There's some cool stuff, go check it out!

Oh, both of these games have new 18+ content for anyone interested ;)

Have fun, and thanks for playing!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44477116/b8828a9439f4fae09f9ea75d7375102ce2300dbe.png

notes.title: AploVVare Collection is out now!
notes.content:
Hey gamers! The AploVVare Collection is out! It's free, go check it out now!

The collection currently has 16 games, each varying in length between 5-20 minutes. I plan on adding more in the future as I create game jam submissions or smaller projects in the future, so stay tuned for more to come!

There's 2 extra DLCs that are available as well:

 Supporter DLC - A paid DLC that adds Developer Commentary & Launcher Skins!
 18+ DLC  - A free DLC that lets you view adult content (you must be an adult to get this, obviously)

I should point out that I wasn't able to finish the Developer Commentary subtitles in time, so the commentary is still technically a work in progress...? But I'll have that finished soon!

If you run into any problems, best way to contact me is to dm me on Discord (@aplove) and I'll try to have the issues fixed ASAP

Thank you for playing! <3
